title: Keyboard only: sign in, open a case, change its status and sign out
preconditions: Demo stack running; mouse and touchpad not used.
steps: Tab from the address bar; use the skip link; sign in; open All cases; open a case; move it to the next status through the confirmation dialog; sign out.
expected: Every control is reachable and operable with Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, arrow keys and Esc; no keyboard trap; focus order follows the visual order.

title: Keyboard only: dialogs move focus in, trap it, close with Esc and restore it
steps: Open the submit confirmation, the status confirmation, the assign dialog, the remove-user dialog and an expanded chart.
expected: Focus moves into each dialog (Cancel first for destructive or submit confirmations); Tab stays inside; Esc closes it and focus returns to the control that opened it.

title: Keyboard focus is never hidden under the sticky header
expected: The focused control is always at least partly visible while tabbing through long pages.

title: NVDA with Chrome or Edge: dashboard KPIs, charts and auto-applied filters
steps: Browse the dashboard by headings and landmarks; read each KPI link; read a chart's summary and data table; change a case list filter and listen for the result count.
expected: Each KPI link reads its label, value and hint; charts read their title and summary; filter changes announce the number of results politely without moving focus.

title: JAWS with Chrome or Edge: new case form errors, confirmation and success
steps: Submit an empty form; follow the error summary links; fix the title; submit; confirm in the dialog.
expected: The error summary is announced and each link moves to its field; fields read their label, hint and error; the dialog reads "Are you sure you want to submit?"; the created case is announced.

title: 200% browser zoom and 320 CSS pixel reflow on every page
expected: No loss of content or function; no two-dimensional scrolling except data tables and charts.

title: Windows high contrast (forced colours): controls, focus, status and charts stay visible
expected: Buttons, inputs, badges, cards and the focus indicator have visible borders; status and priority remain readable as text.

title: Text and non-text contrast measured with a colour analyser
page: Sign in, Dashboard, All cases, Case details
expected: Text 4.5:1 (large text 3:1); control borders, focus indicators and chart marks 3:1 against adjacent colours.
